obligations.scenario: Read responses routed according to acceptance history
obligations.checked_target: Only read commands retain the granted port as an outstanding read owner; write commands do not retain an owner. Except for the first edge after reset deassertion and windows in which capacity is full, read owners are added to an ordered queue on the rising edge of clk_i. When the queue is nonempty and sram_rvalid_i is 1, rsp_rvalid_o combinationally equals the one-hot vector of the oldest owner, and that owner is removed on that rising edge; when sram_rvalid_i is 0, rsp_rvalid_o is all zeros. An empty queue does not produce a port valid even if sram_rvalid_i is 1. Issuing a new read and receiving a return in the same cycle with an empty queue does not bypass the new owner; the new owner can become the queue head only after the acceptance edge.

obligations.checked_target: At most four outstanding read owners are retained. Read commands issued when four entries are already present still receive a grant and an SRAM request, but the new owner is discarded, with neither backpressure nor a dedicated error signal.
